headline: Indian Markets Eye Rally Extension Led by IT Stocks; Reliance Jio IPO and PNB Income Targets in Focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT giants TCS and Tech Mahindra led a 3% weekly surge in major indices
Market sentiment is buoyed by the upcoming Reliance Jio IPO and Q2 earnings expectations
Nifty technicals show a bullish weekly candlestick despite resistance at 23,400-23,800 levels
Investors are navigating significant FPI outflows totaling over Rs 52,000 crore this month
whatHappening: Punjab National Bank aims for Rs 60,000 crore income in the coming quarters
Reliance Communications has filed a curative petition against a previous spectrum ruling
MeitY has issued directives to Meta regarding algorithm reviews and misleading content
Stock exchanges will be closed on Tuesday, October 20, for the Dussehra festival
summary: Indian markets open on October 19 following a strong 3% weekly gain driven by the IT sector and Tech Mahindra. Investors are weighing record FPI outflows of Rs 52,000 crore against optimism for the Reliance Jio IPO and PNB's growth targets. Markets will remain closed on Tuesday for the Dussehra holiday.
